d:
Chirag pasvan ne prashant kishor aur mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri ki vayral tasvir par pratikriya di hai. unhonne kaha ki rajnitik virodh apni jagah hai, lekin vyaktigat mulakaton men samman aur sanvad ki gunjaish bani rahni chahie.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
